title: Sick-Day Runbook Completion SLA
dataSources: Life service health (`lifeos:service`), personal scorecards (`lifeos:score`), breach notifications (`hibp:breach`), location visits (`location:visit`), runbook checklists (`runbook:checklist`), and Home Assistant outage events (`homeassistant:event`).
app: Apple and Google location exports, Have I Been Pwned breach alerts, Todoist-style personal runbooks, and Home Assistant outage events streamed into Splunk HEC under `index=personal`.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=runbook:checklist checklist_type="sick_day"
| stats avg(completion_minutes) as avg_completion_min, max(completion_minutes) as worst_completion_min, avg(step_completion_pct) as avg_completion_pct by owner
| eval avg_completion_pct=round(avg_completion_pct,1)
| sort - worst_completion_min
description: Measures how quickly a sick-day checklist gets completed and how much of the runbook actually gets done.
value: A repeatable sick-day process prevents urgent basics from slipping when energy and attention are low.
implementation: Emit one checklist-completion event with owner, completion minutes, and completion percentage each time the runbook is used.
visualization: Table of owners with average completion time and completion percentage.

references.title: Have I Been Pwned API v3

grandmaExplanation: It counts how quickly your sick-day checklist gets done so the important stuff still happens when you feel rough.
